notLinked:
Hi 👋 I'm the Zentlet assistant. To log your expenses here, connect your account from the app in *Settings → WhatsApp*.
{url}
linked:
✅ All set, {name}! Your WhatsApp is now connected to Zentlet.

Send me your expenses or income the way you'd tell someone:
• lunch 25
• taxi 18 yesterday
• got paid 1500 salary

I also understand voice notes and receipt photos, and you can ask me *how much did I spend this week?*
linkInvalid: That code is invalid or expired. Create a new one in the app under *Settings → WhatsApp*.
linkLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a while and create a new code in the app.
unlinked: Done, this WhatsApp is no longer connected to your account. You can connect it again from the app anytime.
help:
Here's what I can do:
• Log expenses and income: *lunch 25*, *got paid 1500*
• Understand voice notes and receipt photos
• Tell you how much you spent: *how much did I spend this month?*
• *undo*: deletes the last thing I logged
• *cancel*: discards what we were logging
• *unlink*: disconnects this WhatsApp
askCategoryMore: If it's not on the list, type its name.
noCategories: You don't have any categories yet. Create one in the app and message me again.
undone: ↩️ Done, deleted {count, plural, one {the entry} other {# entries}}.
nothingPending: Nothing pending. Send me an expense, for example: *lunch 25*
notUnderstood: I didn't get that 🤔 Send me the expense with its amount, for example: *taxi 18*. Type *help* to see everything I can do.
unsupported: For now I understand text, voice notes and receipt photos.
audioFailed: I couldn't listen to the audio. Could you type it?
imageFailed: I couldn't read the image. Could you type the amount and what it was?
notReceipt: I couldn't find a payment in that image. Could you type the amount and what it was?
busy: I'm getting a lot of messages. Try again in a minute.
failed: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
summaryEmpty: You have no entries from {from} to {to}.
